notes.note: Re-reviewed the complete guide and its connection journeys after main integration and receiver-fixture repair. Traced destination identification, pending Device approval, issued credential verification, explicit inactive-Station reachability check, and explicit switching. The receiver fixture declares only typed configuration, ACP inventory and unbound Starter task reads; its event transport is unavailable, so this does not prove SSE delivery or a provider workload. Product classification now serializes the filesystem-backed receiver fixture; the existing exact-list policy keeper agrees. PR smoke membership, one-worker policy, zero retries and failure retention are unchanged. Executed: E2E type and fixture policy passed; manifest and merged Project-return tests passed 56/56 at 7905e21d36; desktop and phone recovery plus three other connection keepers passed there. The two switching keepers initially failed closed on an undeclared Starter read, then passed 2/2 at 60d42f2d83 after the exact public unbound response was declared. Independent delta review found no remaining issues. Failed receipts and traces retained. No claim of full-suite, hosted, installed iOS, physical-device, remote-provider or canonical qualification; no PNG baseline changed. Guide prose remains accurate as an evidence map rather than a complete-coverage verdict.
